page.overview:
Who is Keith?

Keith is a minor character in the original .

Keith was a young boy who bullied Tommy Doyle along with his friends Lonnie and Richie. Out of the three boys, he seemed the least mean and the tallest. On Halloween 1978, Keith and his friends were trying to make Tommy believe that the boogeyman was coming after him. Later that night, Lonnie was dared to enter the Myers house. However, Samuel Loomis happened to be hiding behind tall bushes and made an attempt to save the children from any possible danger. He successfully scared off the boys.
